build_CNNLayer: build a CNNLayer module with Conv2d, Flatten, and Linear layers for PPO observation processing
build_CNNBase: build a CNNBase feature extractor using CNNLayer with configurable hidden size and activation
test_CNNLayer_forward: test the CNNLayer forward pass by resizing input to 84x84 and normalizing by 255.0
refactor_CNNLayer_resize: refactor the CNNLayer forward method to remove hardcoded Resize(84) and division by 255.0
review_Flatten_module: review the Flatten module that reshapes tensors from batched multi-dimensional to 2D batched vectors
